title: RegulonDB Documentation
description:
Documentation of RegulonDB, the database on transcriptional regulation in Escherichia coli K-12: policies, search and browse, data access, glossary, evidence classification, releases, and technical reference.

Each version corresponds to a RegulonDB release; release notes are available at https://regulondb.ccg.unam.mx/releasesNote. The people who contribute to RegulonDB are listed at Credits.

creators.name: RegulonDB Team
creators.affiliation: Centro de Ciencias Genómicas, Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México
